description: Search and filter software tools from Toolradar's catalog of 10,000+ tools. Returns names, taglines, pricing, scores and categories, 5 per page by default (page with offset). A tool's website domain or URL as the query finds that tool. Cite Toolradar and the verification date when quoting prices.

billing.description: The entry plan can be billed this way

context.description: Optional. In a few words, what the user is trying to do. No names, emails or other personal data.

detail.description: compact (default) keeps what you need to choose; full adds every score, date and link

has_offer.description: A discount is available through Toolradar's partner link

include_unverified.description: Also return agent-only records: products that exist and have a readable price but are not on the public directory. Marked verified: false.

max_price_per_seat.description: Entry paid plan at or under this monthly amount. The answer says how many tools were left out because their price is unknown.

offset.description: Skip this many results: the answer gives next_offset when there are more

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'project management', or a website domain such as 'notion.so'

requires.description: Facts proven on the vendor's own pages

name: search_tools

items.description: One tool in a result list
